capabilities.label: Corporate cards
capabilities.detail: unlimited physical & virtual cards, single-use/recurring virtual cards, purpose-specific cards, preset limits by card/category, category & merchant restrictions (auto-block), vendor-level approvals, card locking on violation, auto coding/reconciliation, no annual fees/interest, Visa in 200+ countries, local card issuing in 30+ countries

capabilities.label: Cashback/rewards
capabilities.detail: up to ~5% cashback, redeemable for travel/gift cards/deposits, $350k+ partner offers, Automatic Payment Agent routes card-eligible bills to earn cashback
features: Automatic Payment Agent routes card-eligible bills to earn cashback

capabilities.label: Expense management
capabilities.detail: OCR receipt auto-capture, smart receipt matching, auto-categorization, multi-channel submission (web/mobile/SMS/Slack/Teams), automatic mileage tracking, per diem, reimbursements in 1–2 days, non-employee/global reimbursement in 60+ countries & 40 currencies, missing-receipt reminders

capabilities.label: Policy enforcement
capabilities.detail: pre-transaction spend controls, real-time flagging/blocking of out-of-policy, dynamic policy builder, Policy Agent reviews 100% of expenses (approves compliant, escalates risky)
features: Policy Agent reviews 100% of expenses (approves compliant, escalates risky)

capabilities.label: Bill pay/AP automation
capabilities.detail: invoice OCR at 99% accuracy, AI line-item transcription, auto-coding agent (learns GL mapping), custom approval workflows, Approval Agent with recommendations, 2-way & 3-way PO matching, duplicate detection, Fraud Prevention Agent (flags vendor bank-detail changes), recurring/scheduled bills, batch payments, AP aging, bidirectional ERP sync (NetSuite/QuickBooks/Sage Intacct)
features: Fraud Prevention Agent (flags vendor bank-detail changes)

capabilities.label: Payment methods
capabilities.detail: ACH & same-day ACH, one-time virtual card, paper checks, domestic & international wire (USD + foreign), pay vendors in 200+ countries

capabilities.label: Procurement
capabilities.detail: AI-powered intake (parses contracts/screenshots), customizable request forms, dynamic & parallel approval routing, Slack approvals, auto-generated POs, virtual card issuance, 3-way matching with payment blocking, Ironclad & Okta integrations

capabilities.label: Vendor management
capabilities.detail: centralized vendor database, automated record creation, W-9 collection & 1099 automation (form population + IRS filing), vendor self-service portal, compliance-doc collection, renewal reminders, quote benchmarking
features: W-9 collection & 1099 automation (form population + IRS filing)

capabilities.label: Travel (Ramp Travel)
capabilities.detail: in-app flight/hotel/car booking, real-time policy status at booking, pre-spend enforcement, intelligent approval routing, auto trip creation & expense aggregation, hotel price monitoring with auto-rebook, works with any provider, 24/7 travel support (Plus)

capabilities.label: Accounting automation
capabilities.detail: automatic coding, real-time bidirectional GL sync, auto-categorization, receipt matching, month-end close acceleration, integrations with QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite/Sage Intacct (+ Workday/Oracle Fusion on Enterprise), custom accounting rules
features: integrations with QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite/Sage Intacct (+ Workday/Oracle Fusion on Enterprise)

capabilities.label: Budgets/reporting
capabilities.detail: budgets by department/project/vendor with automated enforcement, real-time tracking, overspend alerts; real-time spend reports, custom dashboards & report builder, natural-language/AI reporting, Compliance Dashboard
features: budgets by department/project/vendor with automated enforcement

capabilities.label: Ramp Intelligence (AI agents)
capabilities.detail: Policy Enforcement Agent, Approval Agent, AP Agents (transcription/categorization/3-way matching), Fraud Detection, Expense Auto-Coding, Price Negotiation Intelligence (benchmarks vs 70,000+ businesses), Hotel Price Monitoring, Vendor Payment Automation

capabilities.label: Treasury/business account
capabilities.detail: Ramp Business Checking (variable APY, instant payments), Ramp Investment Account (managed fixed-income), FDIC insurance via IntraFi ICS, SIPC on investments, no fees/minimums, free same-day ACH & international wires, RTP, virtual accounts with auto-reject, Target Balance auto-transfer, 13-week cash-flow forecasting

capabilities.label: FX/global/controls
capabilities.detail: multi-currency, international payments, reimburse in 60+ countries/40 currencies, local card issuing in 30+ countries, SSO, role-based access + audit logging (Plus), multi-entity, 200+ integrations
